records.subject: You're in -- let's get River Group set up
records.body:
Hi Theo,

Welcome to Wrenfield. There's no wrong way to start -- create a project, add a few tasks, invite people, and adjust as you figure out what works for your team.

Reply here if you need a hand.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Project created day 0 and 1 invite sent (facts), so setup momentum exists, but no key milestone in 6 days and customer's reply [email:5c0ea0c2] was polite but passive ("will reach out if anything comes up"), signaling low urgency. Starter, no tickets, 8 days left: moderate chance unaided.

draft.subject: Re: Quick check-in from Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Theo,

Thanks for the quick note - glad the first week has gone well and that someone else is in there with you.

Since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, the natural next step is getting a few real tasks into that first River Group project so you and your teammate are working from the same place.

If it's useful, I'm happy to walk through that one next step with you on a short call this week - otherwise just reply here and I'll help by email.

Best,
Nadia
